notes: v1.0.21 — Security hardening & seller application integrity
- Seller applications now lock once submitted — no editing store details or swapping verification documents while pending review
- Every seller approval/rejection is logged with who, when, and notes
- Admin portal: view seller verification documents (ID, selfie, product photos)
- Map API key removed from the app — maps and geocoding now run through a secure server proxy
- Rate limiting added to public services to block abuse and overload
- Tighter upload rules for storage (file type + size checks)
